{{Top|leg}}
Little is known about the origin of '''Amplification''' crystals. Two of these silver crystals were used by [[Maulkiller]], an experiment of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] who was created by using genetic data from [[Galen Marek]] and [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]]. Maulkiller eventually died due to physical and mental instabilities, and the fate of his crystals was unknown.

{{Tech-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'', these crystals can only be unlocked using a GameStop pre-order code. The crystals provide extra damage from all attacks.
